records.text: is a lot of what Charlie (Charlie Kirk) predicted: that his death would contribute to a wider awakening. I wish he did not have to die for a wider awakening, of course. Um, but I now try to see things like the people coming together, of the left and the right coming together, and us just calling BS instantly on a lot of these narratives as a consequence, because the devil overplayed his hand. Christy (commenter; surname unverified)—Christy (commenter; surname unverified) writes, 'Candace, we don't know, no, but we know who may be behind this.'
records.speaker: Candace Owens
